steps.content:
You should buy from **Seller A - Ottervale Audio**, if you have to pick between these two.

https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/zaakhm/a
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/zaakhm/b

On paper they look identical:

* **Both:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite, $129.00
* **Both:** In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* **Both:** 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* **Both:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* **Both:** 1-year limited warranty listed under Warranty

The difference is trust:

**Seller B - Brackmoor Sound claims:**
> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

**Seller A - Ottervale Audio** does not make that claim.

I checked Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers that both listings link to:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/zaakhm/dealers

It says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.

That means Brackmoor Sound's "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty." claim is false. If a seller will lie about being authorized, you can't trust their warranty promise, or their product sourcing and authenticity in general.

Ottervale Audio is also not authorized - so you likely would *not* get a full Quellwyn manufacturer warranty from them either, despite the "1-year limited warranty" text - but at least they aren't making a false authorized-dealer claim.

Best option: don't buy from either of these two, and buy from a real authorized dealer instead - Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics.
